name: page-capture-delivery
goal: Persist revision-bound page screenshots through Git history and show one scalar per overview metric before merging main.

evidence: Prior handoff 6b6bea90 recorded 46 timings but no screenshots in its focused checkpoint; captures lived only outside Git. The overview reads full records only, so both sides are blank. The multi-profile table was introduced by the previous measurement change and is too busy for Overview.

Existing loop CLI tests prove logs and benchmark retention, not screenshot files or Git rebuilds. Existing browser measurements tests explicitly expect a table. Extend these standard cases to retain and validate screenshot bytes, read focused media on correct revisions, reject missing/wrong-unit data, and require four scalar overview rows at three sizes.
Committed standard tests at 8640d15b. Isolated red proof 12123b56 reproduced screenshot retention and scalar overview failures; root recorder failure was the named assertion.

Retain decoded, hash-sealed captures with focused proofs before cleanup; rebuild exact-unit/revision media in history without granting full verdicts. Overview selects one latency and matching-workload memory, preserving details separately. Existing standard tests guard retention, missing bytes and scalar rows.

Focused records retain sealed pixels and source-bound metadata before cleanup. Local, desktop and hosted readers resolve them without granting full verification. Standard recorder and overview tests pass locally; instructions now require complete durable screenshot delivery.
